description: Create a Salesforce record (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Task, Event, Case) from `fields` (API names, e.g. {"LastName":"Mustermann","Company":"Beispiel GmbH"}). Checks required fields first (Account: Name; Contact: LastName; Lead: LastName+Company; Opportunity: Name+StageName+CloseDate; Task/Case: Subject; Event: Subject+StartDateTime+EndDateTime) and a DUPLICATE check (Account by name, Contact/Lead by e-mail): a hit is returned as a question instead of a second record — set allow_duplicate only after a human confirmed it. WRITES into the customer's CRM — permission gate + write log; dry run unless the connection is live.

allow_duplicate.description: Create even if a matching entry already exists

dry_run.description: true = build and log the request but send nothing. Writes are ALWAYS dry runs while the tenant's Salesforce connection has write_mode "dry_run" (the default).

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

name: create_salesforce_record
